name: Hetzner Cloud
author: ndrsgg
description: Hetzner Cloud server info in the Omarchy bar: state, addresses, live CPU, quick copy, and an ssh config that writes itself.

barWidget.description: See every Hetzner Cloud server across your projects, copy its addresses, watch its CPU, and keep ~/.ssh/config in step with the fleet.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll the Hetzner Cloud API for every project token while the panel is open. Five minutes by default; the panel has buttons for 1, 5, 15 and 60.

schema.label: Idle interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to poll while the panel is closed. Never faster than the refresh interval.

schema.label: Sync ~/.ssh/config
schema.description: Write a Host entry for every server into ~/.ssh/config, between the hcloud-sync markers. Off by default; the rest of your ssh config is left alone and backed up before the first write.

schema.label: SSH user
schema.description: User written into every generated Host entry. Hetzner images start with root. Override per project with your own Host block above the markers.

schema.label: SSH identity file
schema.description: IdentityFile written into every generated Host entry. Empty, the default, writes none and lets ssh try your usual keys and the agent. Set it only for a key with an unusual name.
